## What is omnilane? omnilane routes tasks from Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build or Antigravity to the model selected for each kind of work. It is for people and AI assistants who want to use their existing model subscriptions or supported APIs through one command, with explicit permissions and inspectable results. It runs compatible native sub-agents or vendor CLIs, using a local routing table and verified model selectors rather than a new hosted service. ## Install and first run Install and sign in to at least one supported vendor CLI (`codex`, `claude`, `grok` or `agy`), and have Python 3.9+ and npm available. Run this block yourself in a desktop terminal with access to that login; initialization probes the providers and sends a smoke-test dispatch, so it uses your provider quota. Replace the task text if needed; the first task is read-only. ```bash npm i -g omnilane && omnilane resign --init && omnilane doctor && export OMNILANE_AA_OPERATOR_ASSERTED_HUMAN=1 && omnilane route --mode advise --workdir "$PWD" triage "Summarize this project without changing files" ``` Continue to dispatch only after initialization succeeds and doctor reports the targets you need as ready. `--init` creates the first local transport overlay (proof of which model each CLI selector reaches), verifies it, records first-trust signers and backs up `local.sh` before registering it; it refuses an existing overlay. If you are upgrading, use `omnilane resign` instead. Initialization requires an interactive terminal; it cannot approve changed or unsafe signers, and locally self-signed CLIs require separate human review. The export identifies **you, a human at the terminal**. An AI assistant must use its own caller identity, never that export or `--operator-asserted-human`; see the assistant setup in the reference below. You do not need every vendor: unavailable candidates are skipped, subject to the caller's score ceiling and local verification. ## Everyday use Run `omnilane list` to see your effective lanes. Use `triage` for a first look, `bulk-mechanical` for repetitive implementation, `hardest-coding` for difficult code and `hard-judgment` for a second opinion; the full lane table is in the reference. A lane is a fallback chain, not a promise that every model is installed or that a failed provider call will be retried elsewhere. ```bash omnilane list omnilane route --mode advise --workdir "$PWD" triage "Review the project and list the main risks" omnilane route --mode work --workdir "$PWD" bulk-mechanical "Fix the documented typo in README.md" omnilane route --background --mode work --workdir "$PWD" bulk-mechanical "Run the tests and fix the failing cases" omnilane jobs list omnilane jobs wait JOB_ID --timeout 60 omnilane jobs result JOB_ID ``` Replace `JOB_ID` with the ID printed by the background dispatch. `advise` is read-only; `work` permits changes in the selected work directory and restricts agent-tool network access, while the model connection remains available. `jobs wait` waits for an exit; `jobs result` reads the answer. A finished job still needs review of its output, changed files and relevant tests before you accept the work. Assistant-owned native workers have a separate handoff/completion flow described in the reference. ## When a request is refused or re-signing stops A refusal now starts with `omnilane: refused (...)`, a readable reason and `Next:`, followed by the existing JSON. For scripts that require the previous output, set `OMNILANE_REFUSAL_JSON_ONLY=1`. Read `failed_gate`, `reason`, `next_command` and `eligible_lanes`; re-sign summaries also include an `attention` list with a reason and next command for each vendor that needs action. `installed: true` means the verified changes were installed, not that every row is ready. # omnilane [![ci](https://github.com/Seraphim0916/omnilane/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Seraphim0916/omnilane/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Seraphim0916/omnilane)](LICENSE) [![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/Seraphim0916/omnilane?label=version)](https://github.com/Seraphim0916/omnilane/tags) [English](README.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · **简体中文** · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md)
## omnilane 是什么？ omnilane 让 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 或 Antigravity 按工作类型，把任务交给通道指定的模型。它适合希望用同一套命令整合已有模型订阅或支持的 API，并明确控制权限、查看结果的用户和 AI 助手。它通过本地路由表与已验证的模型选择参数，启动兼容的原生子代理或供应商 CLI，不需要另一个托管服务。 ## 安装与首次运行 先安装并登录至少一个支持的供应商 CLI（`codex`、`claude`、`grok` 或 `agy`），并准备好 Python 3.9+ 和 npm。请由你本人在能读取登录状态的桌面终端中执行以下整段；初始化会探测供应商并实际派发一次任务进行验证，因此会使用供应商额度。任务文本可以替换；第一个任务只读取数据。 ```bash npm i -g omnilane && omnilane resign --init && omnilane doctor && export OMNILANE_AA_OPERATOR_ASSERTED_HUMAN=1 && omnilane route --mode advise --workdir "$PWD" triage "概述这个项目的用途，不要修改文件" ``` 初始化成功、doctor 显示所需目标可用后，再继续派发任务。`--init` 会创建第一份本地覆盖文件（记录 CLI 选择参数实际对应哪个模型的验证证据），完成验证、记录首次信任的签名者，并先备份 `local.sh` 再登记；已有覆盖文件时会拒绝运行。升级现有安装请改用 `omnilane resign`。初始化需要交互式终端，不能批准已变更或不安全的签名者；本地自签 CLI 仍需另外由人工检查。 这个环境变量代表**你本人在终端操作**。AI 助手必须使用自己的调用方身份，不能自行设置它或使用 `--operator-asserted-human`；设置方法见后面的参考资料。不必安装所有供应商：系统会跳过不可用的候选，并继续检查调用方分数上限与本地验证。 ## 日常使用 先用 `omnilane list` 查看当前生效的通道。初步检查用 `triage`、重复性实现用 `bulk-mechanical`、困难代码问题用 `hardest-coding`、第二意见用 `hard-judgment`；完整通道表位于参考资料中。通道是一串候选顺序，不保证每个模型都已安装，也不意味着供应商调用失败后会自动换一家重试。 ```bash omnilane list omnilane route --mode advise --workdir "$PWD" triage "检查项目并列出主要风险" omnilane route --mode work --workdir "$PWD" bulk-mechanical "修正 README.md 中已指出的错字" omnilane route --background --mode work --workdir "$PWD" bulk-mechanical "运行测试并修复失败项" omnilane jobs list omnilane jobs wait JOB_ID --timeout 60 omnilane jobs result JOB_ID ``` 将 `JOB_ID` 替换为后台任务返回的编号。`advise` 为只读；`work` 允许修改指定工作目录并限制代理工具的网络访问，模型连接仍然可用。`jobs wait` 等待任务结束，`jobs result` 读取回答；接受结果前，仍应检查输出、文件变更和相关测试。助手自己的原生子代理采用另一套交接与完成报告流程，详见参考资料。 ## 请求被拒绝或重签名停止时 拒绝消息现在先显示 `omnilane: refused (...)`、通俗原因和 `Next:`，随后保留原有 JSON。需要旧输出格式的程序可以设置 `OMNILANE_REFUSAL_JSON_ONLY=1`。先读 `failed_gate`、`reason`、`next_command` 和 `eligible_lanes`；重签名摘要还提供 `attention` 列表，逐一列出需要处理的供应商、原因及下一条命令。`installed: true` 表示已安装通过验证的变更，不代表每个配置都已可用。 下表中的 `VENDOR`、`MODEL` 请替换为诊断消息中的名称。`whoami` 必须单独占用一次工具调用，不加管道、`&&` 或其他命令。 | 看到什么 | 含义 | 下一条命令 | |---|---|---| | `missing-caller-context` / `caller-identity` | 无法读取启动助手时指定的模型或推理强度。 | `omnilane whoami` | | 调用方模型／强度没有评分项 | 普通通道路由需要完全匹配的评分组合。支持的原生子代理可以继承调用方的实际运行环境，但不算达到通道指定的模型目标。 | `omnilane native-context --vendor VENDOR --model MODEL --inherits-caller-runtime --workdir "$PWD"`，再按参考资料使用 `--inherit` 交接 | | `target-above-effective-ceiling` | 目标超过调用方允许的分数；查看拒绝消息中的可用通道。 | `omnilane route --explain hardest-coding` | | `runtime-mapping-unverified` 或 CLI 证据已变化 | 此主机尚未验证该选择参数，或可执行文件已更新。 | `omnilane resign --vendor VENDOR` | | 退出码 2：未配置覆盖文件 | 首次设置尚未完成。 | `omnilane resign --init` — 由人工在交互式桌面终端执行 | | 退出码 20：`needs-login-session` | CLI 尚未登录，或当前进程无法读取桌面登录状态；先在桌面终端登录。 | `omnilane resign --vendor VENDOR` — 在该已登录的终端执行 | | 退出码 20：`cli-not-installed` 或 `review-executable-source` | 缺少 CLI，或可执行文件来源／签名需要检查；批准不能修复无效签名。 | `omnilane doctor`，再按供应商专属指引处理 | | 退出码 20：`provider-verification-incomplete` 或 `verification-needed` | 验证未完成；先处理列出的 API、额度、网络或尚未探测项。 | `omnilane resign --vendor VENDOR` | | 环境失败因冷却期／重置时间暂缓 | 普通失败项可以显式要求重试；无人值守的待复查项仍受重试上限和重置时间约束。 | `omnilane resign --retry-failed --vendor VENDOR` — 先排除原因 | | `deterministic-probe-failure`／模型或强度错误 | 请求与观察结果不符；即使加上 `--retry-failed` 也不会自动重试。 | `omnilane doctor`，修正 CLI／供应商映射后再安排新验证 | | 退出码 60：`partially-re-signed` | 通过的选择参数已安装；保留项待复查，不能派发任务。需要处理的退出码 20 优先。 | `omnilane resign --vendor VENDOR` — 待原因解除后执行 | | 退出码 20：`operator-or-login-needed`，或下一步包含 `--approve`、`--allow-shrink`、`--record-signers` 或信任／撤销标志 | 这是操作者决策，不是助手可以自行批准的权限。 | `omnilane doctor` — 由人工检查证据，再在终端执行指定操作 | ## v0.43.0 新功能 十天之内，0.42.x 有四次把所有模型调用者全部拒绝，每一次都是因为 omnilane 管不到的事实：启动器改了名、runner 脚本改了却没重签、四家厂商 CLI 在同一周各自更新、Codex 定时任务不记录强度。每一件都变成“什么都派不出去”。这一版把它们各自缩小成讲得清楚的结果，最常见的那一种还会自己修好。 - **厂商 CLI 更新了？`omnilane resign`。** 它会找出哪里变了、只重新探测那一家、检查结果、换上去、用一笔真实派工确认，失败就恢复旧的覆盖文件。只有新可执行文件的签署者相同、位置也相同时，才会**无人值守**地重签；其他情况会停下来，打印出你应执行的那一行 `--approve` 命令。先运行一次 `omnilane resign --record-signers`，再把 `omnilane resign` 安排为每天执行，之后 CLI 更新就不再是你的事。已用一次真实的 Codex 自动升级（0.155.0 → 0.155.1）验证：无需批准、映射全部保留、退出码 0。 - **拒绝消息会告诉模型该怎么办。** 每一笔被拒的派工都带着 `failed_gate`、`reason`、`next_command`、`required_caller_effort`，以及 `eligible_lanes`（这个调用者现在*派得动*的通道）。 - **没有记录强度改为缩小范围，不再全拒。** Codex 心跳定时任务会被限制在它那个模型的最低分，而不是每条通道都拒绝。便宜的通道照常可用，贵的会说明需要哪个强度。 - **助手自己的子代理。** `omnilane native-context` 会写出以前必须手写的能力声明文件；`omnilane route --inherit` 规划一个“调用者分身”工人：不经外部 CLI、不看覆盖文件、连调用者身份读不到时也能用，并且诚实标明*不是*该通道的目标模型。已在 Claude Code 与 Codex 桌面版完整跑通。 - **Codex：每次工具调用只下一条 omnilane 命令。** `omnilane whoami; echo $?` 读不到身份，单独的 `omnilane whoami` 读得到。拒绝消息现在会直接这样提示。 - **doctor 能看到搬了家的 CLI**（新版装在旧文件旁边），完全没有覆盖文件时会警告并附上步骤。 - **技能文件与教程重写。** 技能文件现在是模型照着走的五个步骤；这份 README 一步步带你让助手来驾驶 omnilane。 - **限制。** 无人值守重签依赖 macOS 代码签名；在 Linux 上，以及任何没有签名或在本地改过的 CLI，每次更新都会要求你 `--approve`。`--inherit` 还没有在 Grok Build 里跑过，Antigravity 没有提供子代理工具。完整细节见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。 - **升级。** `npm i -g omnilane@0.43.0`，然后执行一次：`omnilane resign --record-signers`。 ## ## What is omnilane? omnilane routes tasks from Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build or Antigravity to the model selected for each kind of work. It is for people and AI assistants who want to use their existing model subscriptions or supported APIs through one command, with explicit permissions and inspectable results. It runs compatible native sub-agents or vendor CLIs, using a local routing table and verified model selectors rather than a new hosted service. ## Install and first run Install and sign in to at least one supported vendor CLI (`codex`, `claude`, `grok` or `agy`), and have Python 3.9+ and npm available. Run this block yourself in a desktop terminal with access to that login; initialization probes the providers and sends a smoke-test dispatch, so it uses your provider quota. Replace the task text if needed; the first task is read-only. ```bash npm i -g omnilane && omnilane resign --init && omnilane doctor && export OMNILANE_AA_OPERATOR_ASSERTED_HUMAN=1 && omnilane route --mode advise --workdir "$PWD" triage "Summarize this project without changing files" ``` Continue to dispatch only after initialization succeeds and doctor reports the targets you need as ready. `--init` creates the first local transport overlay (proof of which model each CLI selector reaches), verifies it, records first-trust signers and backs up `local.sh` before registering it; it refuses an existing overlay. If you are upgrading, use `omnilane resign` instead. Initialization requires an interactive terminal; it cannot approve changed or unsafe signers, and locally self-signed CLIs require separate human review. The export identifies **you, a human at the terminal**. An AI assistant must use its own caller identity, never that export or `--operator-asserted-human`; see the assistant setup in the reference below. You do not need every vendor: unavailable candidates are skipped, subject to the caller's score ceiling and local verification. ## Everyday use Run `omnilane list` to see your effective lanes.
